import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
p='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'
df=pd.read_excel(p,header=1)
df=df.rename(columns={df.columns[0]:'miRNA'}).set_index('miRNA')
print(df.shape, df.columns.tolist())
print('numeric counts >=34, missing:',(df>=34).sum().sum(),df.isna().sum().sum())
cols=[c for c in df if c not in ['P_3','C_18']]
P=[c for c in cols if c.startswith('P_')]
C=[c for c in cols if c.startswith('C_')]
print(P,C)
means=df[cols].where(df[cols]<34).mean(axis=0)
print('means',means.to_dict())
for cutoff in ['mask_ge34','retain_ge34']:
 x=df[cols].copy()
 if cutoff=='mask_ge34': x=x.where(x<34)
 z=means-x
 for eq in [True,False]:
  ps=[]
  for _,row in z.iterrows():
   a=row[P].dropna().values; b=row[C].dropna().values
   ps.append(ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=eq).pvalue if len(a)>=2 and len(b)>=2 else np.nan)
  ps=np.array(ps,float)
  for m_mode in ['finite','all175']:
   finite=np.isfinite(ps)
   # statsmodels adjustment finite uses m finite; emulate R n 175 by padding 1s if needed
   qbon=np.full(len(ps),np.nan); qby=np.full(len(ps),np.nan)
   if m_mode=='finite':
    qbon[finite]=multipletests(ps[finite],method='bonferroni')[1]
    qby[finite]=multipletests(ps[finite],method='fdr_by')[1]
   else:
    full=np.r_[ps[finite],np.ones((~finite).sum())]
    qbon[finite]=multipletests(full,method='bonferroni')[1][:(finite.sum())]
    qby[finite]=multipletests(full,method='fdr_by')[1][:(finite.sum())]
   print(cutoff,'equal_var',eq,'m',m_mode,'finite',finite.sum(),'raw',sum(ps<=.05),'bon',sum(qbon<=.05),'by',sum(qby<=.05),'min',np.nanmin(ps))
   sig=np.where(qby<=.05)[0]
   print(' BY sig',[(df.index[i],ps[i],qbon[i],qby[i]) for i in sig])
PY"

from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, ttest_rel
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
p='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls'; d=pd.read_excel(p,header=1); d=d.rename(columns={d.columns[0]:'miRNA'}).set_index('miRNA').apply(pd.to_numeric,errors='coerce')
cols=[c for c in d if c not in ['P_3','C_18']]; P=[c for c in cols if c[0]=='P'];C=[c for c in cols if c[0]=='C']
for meanmode in ['lt34','all','le34','raw_ct']:
 means=d[cols].where(d[cols]<34).mean() if meanmode=='lt34' else d[cols].where(d[cols]<=34).mean() if meanmode=='le34' else d[cols].mean()
 for mask in ['lt34','none']:
  x=d[cols].where(d[cols]<34) if mask=='lt34' else d[cols]
  z=x if meanmode=='raw_ct' else means-x
  for test in ['equal','welch','paired']:
   ps=[]
   for _,r in z.iterrows():
    if test=='paired':
     a=r[P].values; b=r[C].values; ok=np.isfinite(a)&np.isfinite(b); a=a[ok];b=b[ok]
     pv=ttest_rel(a,b).pvalue if len(a)>=2 else np.nan

     a=r[P].dropna();b=r[C].dropna();pv=ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=test=='equal').pvalue if len(a)>=2 and len(b)>=2 else np.nan

   ps=np.array(ps); ok=np.isfinite(ps); bon=multipletests(ps[ok],method='bonferroni')[1]; by=multipletests(ps[ok],method='fdr_by')[1]
   print(meanmode,mask,test,'n',ok.sum(),'raw',sum(ps<=.05),'bon',sum(bon<=.05),'by',sum(by<=.05),'min',np.nanmin(ps),'gene',d.index[np.nanargmin(ps)])

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind
p='inputs/pone.0150501.s002.xls';d=pd.read_excel(p,header=1);d=d.rename(columns={d.columns[0]:'miRNA'}).set_index('miRNA').apply(pd.to_numeric,errors='coerce').drop(columns=['P_3','C_18']);P=[c for c in d if c[0]=='P'];C=[c for c in d if c[0]=='C'];m=d.where(d<34).mean();z=m-d.where(d<34);ps=[]
for i,r in z.iterrows(): ps.append((i,ttest_ind(r[P].dropna(),r[C].dropna(),equal_var=True).pvalue))
ps=sorted([(i,p) for i,p in ps if np.isfinite(p)],key=lambda t:t[1]);M=len(ps);H=sum(1/i for i in range(1,M+1))
print('m',M,'H',H)
for rank,(i,pv) in enumerate(ps[:15],1): print(rank,i,'p',pv,'bon',min(pv*M,1),'BY raw multiplier',min(pv*M*H/rank,1),'BY rejection threshold',rank*.05/(M*H))
